test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL - General Awareness (Held on: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following comes under 5th schedule of the Indian constitution?

options.text: Provisions related to Schedule Areas and Scheduled Tribes
Provisions related to Tribal areas in states of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram
Provisions related to Oaths or Affirmations

solution:
The correct answer is __**Provisions related to Schedule Areas and Scheduled Tribes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Schedule 5 of the Indian Constitution

__
 
• The administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes are addressed in the Fifth Schedule. 
 
• Article 244(1) is directly related to Schedule 5. Ten states currently have Fifth Schedule Areas: Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Rajasthan, and Telangana.
 
• The criteria for declaring an area as Scheduled Area are as follows:
 
 
• a preponderance of the tribal population;
 
• compactness and reasonable size of the area;
 
• under-developed nature of the area; and
 
• the marked disparity in the economic standard of the people.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
